breakpoints.note: Attacker-controlled string is first consumed to compute len, which determines the loop bounds for processing characters into the uninitialized stack buffer.

Stack buffer of 23 bytes declared without initialization. Only characters explicitly written via buf[buf_used++] and the null terminator buf[buf_used]=0 become initialized; remaining bytes retain indeterminate stack content.

strcmp is compiler-optimized to memcmp(buf, "ECDSA", 6), reading 6 bytes from buf unconditionally. When buf_used < 5, bytes beyond the null terminator are uninitialized stack memory. MSAN detects uninitialized bytes at offset 2 within the 6-byte read region.
